name: constraint-scope
body: Constraints are layer-scoped. `rust.apg.layers.validate.eval_constraint` is the shared structural check (name, layer/type, uniqueness) that the write path and the scan path both call; it establishes a constraint's layer as its scope. `rust.apg.layers.write.validate_change` accepts a constraint written with its scope in its layer, and accepts an existing constraint's `attaches-to` value as it stands in the spec. The scan path `rust.apg.layers.tree.ingest_tree` loads every constraint, and `apg spec lint` reports each constraint that carries an `attaches-to`.
